description: Talks on one day that assume a given concept, with all the concepts each one assumes. Use it to find talks that build on something the student knows.

configuration.query: FROM sessions | WHERE is_talk == true AND DATE_FORMAT("yyyy-MM-dd", day) == ?day | EVAL needs = assumes, local = starts_at - 7 hours, time = DATE_FORMAT("EEE HH:mm", local) | MV_EXPAND assumes | WHERE assumes == ?concept | SORT local | KEEP title, time, room, needs | LIMIT 100

day.description: The day as YYYY-MM-DD. KubeCon talks run 2026-11-09 (Mon) to 2026-11-12 (Thu).

concept.description: A concept slug such as networking-basics (not its name; look the slug up with homeroom.concept.define first).
